WHO targets snakebite as a neglected hazard.

The World Health Organization has identified venomous snakebite as a neglected hazard afflicting tropical countries. Read about the WHO Global Snakebite Initiative on their website here.

Snakebite and Venomous Snake Awareness Presentation

AVRI on occasion gives snakebite information presentations to animal control personnel and other professionals that may come into contact with venomous snakes. See our presentation, prepared by former AVRI President Chris Harper, NREMT-P, EMT-T, CAS and overviewed by Dr. Dan Keyler, Pharm.D. here.
